sections.label: Naming date of resumption
sections.summary: The Speaker names the date of resumption in place of Mr Pillai, who is in an ongoing Court hearing and has no objections.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Ordinarily the mover of the Motion would be the person to name the date of resumption.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But Mr Pillai is engaged in a Court hearing which is still ongoing and he is not able to be here at this present time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, I have discussed with him what to do in that event and he has no objections to my naming the date in his place.
